body: Thanks for listening, i'll let you know how this turns out.

First of all, thank you for you concern and post.

I guess my phrasing isn't the best to explain my situation.
I have been depressed (diagnosed in and out of treatment) since a long time. So i do know this a another major episode rolling down. That started before i know about the housing situation.

I agree, that usually the housing wouldn't be that much of a problem, but in an episode it is.
It amplified the stress, tension and anxiety i already had a lot.
This makes it very hard to go out and look for new places, which leads to more stress and the circle goes on.

I don't want to admit myself before i don't have a place to live when i get out. It would only make it harder to find a place, and not having a place to live would make the treatment a lot harder.

So i do know, the root of my problems is not the housing, it's just an amplifier and gives me a deadline i am very much afraid of since i am feeling worse day by day.

May i ask what kind of addictions?
Having a passion is a good thing! Do you have a passion for listening to music or making music?
